mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.consttsincry.mapper.ConsttSincryMapper.selectCombo1List : 통합기관 LIST */ AA.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , AA.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , AA.INST_NO AS INST_NO , '4' AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /** 기관유형구분코드 사이버상담(4) **/ FROM SAA300 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INST_NO = '371' /** 청소년사이버상담센터 **/

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.mapper.ConsttSrvyExmnInptCdMapper.selectCombo3List : 기관 상담원 LIST */ AA.USER_ID AS ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT) AS NAME FROM SAA200 AA , SCA100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.ENFSN_NO = BB.ENFSN_NO AND BB.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} AND AA.JOIN_APRV_YN = 'Y' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N'

/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.consttsincry.mapper.ConsttSincryMapper.selectConsttSincryCnsltntList : 상담원별 LIST */ WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{yyyyMm} AS YYYYMM , #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT LL.FLNM AS FLNM , LL.USER_ID , LL.BGNG_HR , LL.END_HR , LL.CHAT_BGNG_DT , LL.LVFFC_DT , LL.BIGO AS BIGO , LL.FLNM || '님의 근무일수: '|| (LL.A100-LL.A66-LL.A77-LL.A99) ||' 일, 총 지각: '|| LL.A11 ||'회, 총 지각 시간: ' || FLOOR(LL.A200) ||' 분, 총 휴가: '|| LL.A99 || ' 건, 총 결근: '|| LL.A66 || ' 건' AS MSG , '님의 근무일수: '|| (LL.A100-LL.A66-LL.A77-LL.A99) ||' 일, 총 지각: '|| LL.A11 ||'회, 총 지각 시간: ' || FLOOR(LL.A200) ||' 분, 총 휴가: '|| LL.A99 || ' 건, 총 결근: '|| LL.A66 || ' 건' AS MSG2 , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ( SELECT KK.USER_ID , KK.FLNM , KK.BGNG_HR , KK.END_HR , KK.CHAT_BGNG_DT , KK.LVFFC_DT , SUM(KK.A00) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A00 , SUM(KK.A11) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A11 , SUM(KK.A66) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A66 , SUM(KK.A77) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A77 , SUM(KK.A99) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A99 , COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A100 /* 근무 일수 */ , SUM(KK.A200) OVER(PARTITION BY KK.USER_ID) AS A200 /* 지각 시간 */ , KK.BIGO FROM ( SELECT JJ.FLNM , JJ.USER_ID , JJ.BGNG_HR , JJ.END_HR , JJ.CHAT_BGNG_DT , JJ.LVFFC_DT , DECODE(JJ.BIGO, '00', 1, 0) AS A00 , DECODE(JJ.BIGO, '11', 1, 0) AS A11 , DECODE(JJ.BIGO, '66', 1, 0) AS A66 , DECODE(JJ.BIGO, '77', 1, 0) AS A77 , DECODE(JJ.BIGO, '99', 1, 0) AS A99 , JJ.A200 , CASE WHEN JJ.BIGO = '00' THEN '정상' WHEN JJ.BIGO = '11' THEN '지각' WHEN JJ.BIGO = '66' THEN '결근' WHEN JJ.BIGO = '77' THEN '미처리' WHEN JJ.BIGO = '99' THEN '휴가' END AS BIGO FROM ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM , EE.USER_ID AS USER_ID , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ) , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS') AS BGNG_HR , CASE WHEN DD.END_HR = '00:30' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.END_HR,':','' ) , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS') ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.END_HR,':','' ) , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS') END AS END_HR , TO_CHAR(NVL(TT.ATENDB_DT,''), 'AM HH:MI:SS') AS CHAT_BGNG_DT , TO_CHAR(NVL(TT.LVFFC_DT,''), 'AM HH:MI:SS') AS LVFFC_DT , CASE WHEN (TT.ATENDB_DT - TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))*24*60 > 0 THEN CASE WHEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') > SYSDATE THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC130 HH /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND HH.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.WORK_YMD BETWEEN HH.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND HH.VCATN_END_YMD AND HH.APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND HH.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND HH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN TT.ATENDB_DT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE /* 지각 시간 = 계산된 지각 시간 + 정의된 지각 유효 시간 */ (TT.ATENDB_DT - (TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')))*24*60 END END END ELSE 0 END AS A200 , CASE WHEN (TT.ATENDB_DT - TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))*24*60 > 0 THEN CASE WHEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') > SYSDATE THEN '77' /* 미처리 */ ELSE CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC130 HH /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND HH.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.WORK_YMD BETWEEN HH.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND HH.VCATN_END_YMD AND HH.APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND HH.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND HH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) > 0 THEN '99' /* 휴가 */ ELSE CASE WHEN TT.ATENDB_DT IS NULL THEN '66' /* 결근 */ ELSE '11' /* 지각 */ END END END ELSE CASE WHEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') > SYSDATE THEN '77' /* 미처리 */ ELSE CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC130 HH /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND HH.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.WORK_YMD BETWEEN HH.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND HH.VCATN_END_YMD AND HH.APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND HH.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND HH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) > 0 THEN '99' /* 휴가 */ ELSE CASE WHEN TT.ATENDB_DT IS NULL THEN '66' /* 결근 */ ELSE '00' /* 정상 */ END END END END AS BIGO FROM SAA200 BB /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 CC /* 종사자 */ , AYC110 DD /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , ( SELECT EE.* , DD.BGNG_HR , DD.END_HR FROM AYC100 EE /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC110 DD /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND DD.CRTR_YM = ZZ.YYYYMM AND DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} AND EE.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND SUBSTR(EE.WORK_YMD,1,6) = DD.CRTR_YM AND EE.USER_ID = ZZ.USER_ID ) EE /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC495 TT /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND BB.USER_ID = ZZ.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND CC.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */ AND DD.CRTR_YM = ZZ.YYYYMM AND DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} AND EE.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND SUBSTR(EE.WORK_YMD,1,6) = DD.CRTR_YM AND TT.CONSTT_ID(+) = EE.USER_ID AND TT.WORK_YMD(+) = EE.WORK_YMD ) JJ ) KK ) LL ORDER BY 1 , 3

WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{yyyyMm} AS YYYYMM FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.consttsincry.mapper.ConsttSincryMapper.selectConsttSincryDalyList : 일별 LIST */ HH.FLNM , HH.BGNG_HR , HH.END_HR , HH.CHAT_BGNG_DT , HH.LVFFC_DT , HH.USER_ID , HH.TOTAL_COUNT , HH.A200 , CASE WHEN HH.BIGO = '00' THEN '정상' WHEN HH.BIGO = '77' THEN '미처리' WHEN HH.BIGO = '99' THEN '휴가' WHEN HH.BIGO = '66' THEN '결근' WHEN HH.BIGO = '11' THEN '지각' ELSE '' END AS BIGO FROM ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS') AS BGNG_HR , CASE WHEN DD.END_HR = '00:30' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.END_HR,':','' ) , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS') ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.END_HR,':','' ) , 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS') END AS END_HR , TO_CHAR(NVL(TT.ATENDB_DT,''), 'AM HH:MI:SS') AS CHAT_BGNG_DT , TO_CHAR(NVL(TT.LVFFC_DT,''), 'AM HH:MI:SS') AS LVFFC_DT , EE.USER_ID AS USER_ID , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , CASE WHEN (TT.ATENDB_DT - TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))*24*60 > 0 THEN CASE WHEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') > SYSDATE THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC130 HH /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND HH.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.WORK_YMD BETWEEN HH.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND HH.VCATN_END_YMD AND HH.APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND HH.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND HH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) > 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN TT.ATENDB_DT IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE /* 지각 시간 = 계산된 지각 시간 + 정의된 지각 유효 시간 */ (TT.ATENDB_DT - TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))*24*60 END END END ELSE 0 END AS A200 , CASE WHEN (TT.ATENDB_DT - TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))*24*60 > 0 THEN CASE WHEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') > SYSDATE THEN '77' /* 미처리 */ ELSE CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC130 HH /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND HH.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.WORK_YMD BETWEEN HH.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND HH.VCATN_END_YMD AND HH.APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND HH.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND HH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) > 0 THEN '99' /* 휴가 */ ELSE CASE WHEN TT.ATENDB_DT IS NULL THEN '66' /* 결근 */ ELSE '11' /* 지각 */ END END END ELSE CASE WHEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(DD.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') > SYSDATE THEN '77' /* 미처리 */ ELSE CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYC130 HH /* 사이버1388휴가 */ WHERE 1=1 AND HH.USER_ID = BB.USER_ID AND EE.WORK_YMD BETWEEN HH.VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND HH.VCATN_END_YMD AND HH.APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND HH.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND HH.DEL_YN = 'N' ) > 0 THEN '99' /* 휴가 */ ELSE CASE WHEN TT.ATENDB_DT IS NULL THEN '66' /* 결근 */ ELSE '00' /* 정상 */ END END END END AS BIGO FROM SAA200 BB /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 CC /* 종사자 */ , AYC110 DD /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , ( SELECT EE.* , DD.BGNG_HR , DD.END_HR FROM AYC110 DD /* 근무배정표_월별 */ , AYC100 EE /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND DD.CRTR_YM = SUBSTR(ZZ.YYYYMM,1,6) AND DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} AND EE.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND EE.WORK_YMD = ZZ.YYYYMM ) EE /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC495 TT /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */ , ZZ WHERE 1=1 AND DD.CRTR_YM = SUBSTR(ZZ.YYYYMM,1,6) AND DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} AND EE.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND EE.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD} AND BB.USER_ID = EE.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND CC.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */ AND TT.CONSTT_ID(+) = EE.USER_ID AND TT.WORK_YMD(+) = EE.WORK_YMD ORDER BY 2 , 6 ) HH
